description: The diff config-sync's admin page shows, from the real plugin: each entry that differs between config/sync and the database — `different`, `only-in-db`, `only-in-sync-dir` — with what differs in a few words, and its `likelyDirection` (import | export | unknown) told from the file's git history: the database holding a past version of the file or another branch's → import; something git never had → export (changed in the admin); `why` gives the evidence (`dbMatches` the commit, with `key`). It includes what a start of Strapi changes on its own (a new field in a content-manager view, the super-admin's permissions…): after changing a schema, a controller or a route, these are the entries to export and commit with the code. With `key`, one entry: every difference, and both sides in full when they fit in one answer. It runs the project's code: Strapi is loaded the way config-sync's own CLI does (no server, no port, no admin account), and a load does what a start of `strapi develop` does to the database (schema sync, pending migrations) — so only on a local development database: a remote one, a Strapi 4 database under Strapi 5 code, or a missing SQLite file are refused before Strapi's bootstrap (where it writes to the database). Takes a few seconds.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

key.description: One entry, `<type>.<name>`: every difference, and both sides when they fit.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

type.description: Only the entries of one type (`admin-role`, `user-role`, `core-store`, `plugin_content_manager_configuration`…).

name: config_sync_diff
title: config-sync: the real diff between config/sync and the database
